title: feat: expand GitHub Polli whitelist
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Expands GitHub Polli access from 4 to 7 authorized users across both workflows.
- Adds tomdacatto, YoannDev90, and fisventurous using immutable GitHub user IDs.
- Keeps usernames beside IDs as comments for maintainability.
- Covers the !polli assistant for issue and PR review/coding requests, plus automated fixes for issues labeled POLLI.

gist.headline: Three More Keys to the Hive
gist.blurb: Polli’s GitHub workbench now recognizes three more trusted gardeners. More people can summon the little assistant when issues need tending.
gist.summary: Expanded the GitHub Polli whitelist from 4 to 7 immutable GitHub user IDs in both the !polli assistant workflow and the POLLI-labeled issue auto-fix workflow, with usernames retained as maintenance comments.
gist.impact: tomdacatto, YoannDev90, and fisventurous can now use !polli for issue and PR review or coding requests and trigger automated fixes for POLLI-labeled issues.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy GitHub-style garden gate has seven small nameplates, with three newly planted flowers representing the newly authorized contributors. Polli wears a tiny maintainer cap and checks the access list beside a retro terminal, while code-vines and issue tickets grow nearby.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny maintainer cap, welcoming three new flowers through a garden gate beside a glowing retro GitHub terminal; seven small access badges hang on the gate, code-plants and issue tickets sprout from warm cream pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: "AUTHORIZED".
